name: Aldeaquemada (Spain)
description: Dark green field with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aldeaquemada (an arm holding a burning torch on white within a wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Aldeaquemada; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
